cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
크롤도크 보루 주문력 사슬을
징기가 왜 입찰로 먹어?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor shadow. Low-angle three-quarter view: on the left, the troll shaman throws her hands up with jaw dropped in disbelief; on the right, the undead paladin (with her two-handed golden warhammer sheathed on her back) calmly holds a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold die with round dot pips only and slips a glowing silver interlocking ring-mesh mail-armor belt into her pouch.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
치유 반지는 사제님 주려고
나도 양보했는데 또 먹네?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. Over-the-shoulder angle from behind the human warlock on the left, who points in outrage (spellbook tucked at her waist) while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round purple Voidwalker companion floats beside her waving tiny arms in shock. On the right, the undead paladin (warhammer sheathed on her back) casually holds a dot-pipped die and pockets a sparkling golden-green healing ring.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
이중특성으로 신기 키우려고.
그때 써야 해서 못 줘.
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. Medium side-profile view: on the left, the night elf priest (golden cross staff sheathed on her back) holds both empty hands out politely in a gentle plea; on the right, the undead paladin (warhammer sheathed on her back) turns her chin up with a deadpan sleepy gaze and hugs the sparkling healing ring tightly to her chest.

Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background. Extreme big close-up bust shot filling 80 percent of the frame height: the human warlock stares straight ahead with completely drained soul, wide blank eyes, and jaw dropped open in silent disbelief, while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round purple Voidwalker companion presses right beside her making the exact same stunned blank face.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
진짜 인간혐오 생겼다…
성기사 팟은 절대 안 가!
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. High-angle shot looking down at the center as the human warlock stomps away under a gloomy dark aura, hugging her small purple spellbook while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round purple Voidwalker companion trudges angrily beside her waving tiny fists.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
내 파티에 성기사 들어왔네?
응, 내가 다른 팟 갈게!
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal tavern floor shadow. Wide comedy action shot: on the left, the undead paladin walks up lazily waving one hand (warhammer on her back); on the right, the human warlock (spellbook tucked at her waist) clutches a glowing blue swirl-carved Hearthstone in one hand and drags her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round purple Voidwalker by the arm as she bolts off-frame in a cartoon dust cloud.
